sayLines.line: 📺 RATINGS ARE UP! The producers are pleased. New casting directives incoming — Wave 2 talent has been released into your sector.
📺 TONIGHT: Shelter Swap. Two villagers swap shelters for a week. The aliens film the adjustment. Someone always cries about someone else's storage system.

📺 Shelter Swap — you're living in someone else's shelter for a week.

The aliens film the adjustment. Someone always cries about someone else's storage system. This week, the someone might be you.
📺 You return the shelter cleaner than you found it. The swap is declared a triumph. Jars are respected now.
📺 RATINGS ARE UP! The producers are pleased. New casting directives incoming — Wave 3 talent has been released into your sector.
📡 The next act is not for strangers. The village must be ready to FIGHT the Final Draft — blood your fighters (0 of 1 veterans).
📡 The next act is still waiting — blood your fighters (0 of 1 veterans).
📡 RATINGS ARE UP... Wave 4 talent has been released. The Mirror Draft opens.
📺 RATINGS ARE UP! The producers are pleased. New casting directives incoming — Wave 4 talent has been released into your sector.
📺 TONIGHT: Extreme Burrow Makeover. The aliens redecorate a shelter overnight. It is beautiful. It is unusable. The villager must live in it for a week.

📺 Extreme Burrow Makeover — you wake up redecorated.

The aliens did your shelter overnight. It is beautiful. It is unusable. You must live in it for a week. The reveal is being filmed.
📺 You live in the beautiful unusable shelter with total grace. You learn to sleep diagonally. The galaxy admires your commitment to the bit.
📺 Diagonal sleeping becomes a trend. The shelter is photographed for alien magazines. You are gracious in every one.
📺 TONIGHT: Cribs: Burrow Edition. The aliens tour a villager's shelter. They are horrified. Then delighted. Then they "improve" one thing.

📺 Cribs: Burrow Edition — Lena is on.

The aliens tour a villager's shelter. They are horrified. Then delighted. Then they "improve" one thing.

You watch with the village. The cameras love the watchers almost as much as the watched — what you do in the crowd is content too.
